name: Opportunity Counterspell
body:
You can counterspell without a readied action.

Prerequisite: Quicken Spell, 15 ranks in Spellcraft.

Benefit: You can counterspell any spell cast within line of sight as an immediate action without having readied an action or designated a target (1/round). The DC of your Spellcraft check is increased by 10 when using this feat.
